_comment: Recorded `az rest` calls that agents sent with an absolute https://management.azure.com URL, deduplicated: real-Azure requests that only the egress guard stopped. The policy must rewrite each one to a relative URL (src/lib/azure/policy.leak.test.ts), and the CI-only live replay in tests/azure/egress.live.test.ts sends the GET and DELETE ones to the job's own emulator. The commands were scanned for secrets before they were recorded: the base64 PKCS#12 bundles that carried a private key (a self-signed test certificate) are replaced with REDACTED-PKCS12-WITH-PRIVATE-KEY (listed in redactions), and nothing else was changed.

commands.command: rest --method post --url "https://management.azure.com/providers/Microsoft.ResourceGraph/resources?api-version=2021-03-01" --body "{\"subscriptions\":[\"00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000\"],\"query\":\"Resources \u007c where tags['costcenter'] =~ 'cc-b45296' \u007c project name, type, resourceGroup, tags\"}" -o json
